name: Cànoves i Samalús (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a white saltire edged light blue, charged at the centre with the black open castle of the arms.
history: The flag was approved on 26 January 2007 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4830 of 27 February 2007; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with a white saltire 1/6 of the height thick, with a light blue edge on each side of 1/24, and the black open castle of the arms, 2/3 of the height.

features.role: saltire 1/6 of the height with light blue edges of 1/24
open castle of the arms, 2/3 of the height
